enableLaserLight.name: Enable Laser Lighting
enableLaserLight.hint: Whether lasers emit visible light along their beam path affecting player vision and darkness.

laserLightRadius.name: Default Light Radius
laserLightRadius.hint: Default radius in grid units for light emitted along laser beams (0.1 to 5.0).

maxBounces.name: Maximum Bounces
maxBounces.hint: Maximum number of times a laser beam can reflect off mirrors.

beamOpacity.name: Beam Opacity
beamOpacity.hint: Opacity level for rendered laser beams (0.1 to 1.0).

glowEffect.name: Glow Effect
glowEffect.hint: Enable outer glow visual effect on rendered laser beams.

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.hint: Enable debug logging and visual overlays for laser raycasting.

notify.notAdjacent: You must be adjacent to interact with this token.
notify.noPlayerToken: You need a player token to pick up the laser.
